AND 1. THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH  POLICE STATION NARYAWALI, DISTRICT SAGAR  (MADHYA PRADESH)
2. VICTIM A D/O NOT MENTION NOT MENTION  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 .....RESPONDENTS (BY SHRI C.S. PARMAR - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER

This is second bail application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant in connection with Crime No.85/2022, registered at Police Station Naryawali, District Sagar (M.P.), for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(N), 376(2)(F), 343 of IPC and under Section 5(N) r/w Section 6, 5(L) r/w Section 6 of POCSO Act.
2. First application filed by applicant was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file repeat application after examination of prosecutrix.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that prosecutrix has been examined in Court.
Now, there is no chances to tamper with evidence or influence the witnesses of the case.
In these circumstances, applicant may be released on bail.
4. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for respondent/State opposed the prayer for grant of bail and submitted that prosecutrix is minor aged about 16 years.
Considering the nature of offence committed by applicant, application be dismissed.

5. Heard the counsel for the parties.
6.

Considering the fact that prosecutrix has already been examined in Court and applicant is in jail since 01.04.2022, bail application filed by applicant i s allowed on condition that applicant will mark his presence before concerned police station on 1 st of every month.

7. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.
8. The applicant shall abide by the following conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
